segments.name: Roofing
segments.description: Makes asphalt roofing shingles and related components, oxidized asphalt and glass mat materials for residential construction and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Our primary products in the Roofing segment are laminate asphalt roofing shingles.

segments.name: Insulation
products: bonded and granulated stone wool insulation
segments.description: Provides residential, commercial and industrial insulation products across the United States, Canada, Europe and Latin America.
segments.evidence: Our Insulation segment includes a diverse portfolio of high, mid and low-temperature products with a geographic mix of United States, Canada, Europe and Latin America.

segments.name: Doors
products: door components such as frames, sills, weather-stripping, hinges and locks
segments.description: Makes residential interior and exterior doors and door systems for repair, remodel and new construction markets.
segments.evidence: Our primary products in the Doors segment are residential interior and exterior doors made of wood, glass, fiberglass and metal, and door components such as frames, sills, weather-stripping, hinges and locks.

revenueModel.text: The company sells building products to distributors, home centers, lumberyards, retailers, contractors, installers and dealers across wholesale and retail channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell shingles and roofing components primarily through distributors, home centers and lumberyards in the United States.

changes.text: In 2025, the company agreed to sell its global glass reinforcements business, historically part of the Composites segment, which is now reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025, the GR business's financial results are reflected in the Company's consolidated financial statements as discontinued operations for all periods presented.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired Masonite International Corporation, creating the Doors segment.
changes.evidence: On May 15, 2024, the Company acquired all of the outstanding shares of Masonite International Corporation ("Masonite"), a leading global designer, manufacturer, marketer and distributor of interior and exterior doors and door systems for the residential new construction and residential repair and remodeling markets.
